slowest_experiments.experiment: Reconcile fourteen outcomes and decide whether evidence or learning improved
Test dependency-scoped checks for continuous constraint admission
Validate the live ARC outcome frontier with bounded consumer receipts
Localize CUDA failure and bind the current qualified execution contract
Carry GateMate physical-change evidence and its exact reopening condition

summary: Milestone 2026.10.716 completed 6 experiments (1 compute-bound, 5 synthesis-only) across 69.0 total wall-time minutes (averaging 11 minutes per experiment) reconstructed from disk-mtime fallback data. Execution wall time was dominated by synthesis-only tasks accounting for four of the top 5 slowest runs—reconciling fourteen outcomes (20.94 minutes), dependency-scoped continuous constraint admission checks (15.18 minutes), validating the live ARC outcome frontier (10.64 minutes), and GateMate physical-change tracking (7.02 minutes)—alongside the sole compute-bound task localizing CUDA failure (8.29 minutes). With gpu_idle_on_compute_bound_tasks recorded as false, the snapshot of 0% GPU utilization on the NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090 represents expected idle state for synthesis tasks rather than an accelerator stall, and single-model workloads correctly avoided multi-model DualGPURunner dispatch.
bottlenecks_identified: Synthesis-only tasks accounted for the vast majority of wall time (four of the top five slowest experiments totaled 53.78 minutes of the 69.0 milestone wall-time minutes), led by fourteen-outcome reconciliation (20.94 minutes) and dependency-scoped constraint admission checks (15.18 minutes).

The single compute-bound task ('Localize CUDA failure and bind the current qualified execution contract') took 8.29 minutes, but lacks intra-task phase breakdown telemetry (driver verification, context initialization, memory transfer, contract qualification) to isolate execution latency.

Synthesis tasks executed serially across outcome reconciliation, ARC frontier validation, and GateMate evidence checks without incremental receipt caching or evidence memoization when upstream inputs were unchanged.
Milestone timing analysis relied on disk-mtime reconstruction fallbacks due to missing synchronous start and finish execution timestamps in experiment receipts.
improvements_suggested: Implement incremental receipt caching and evidence memoization for fourteen-outcome reconciliation, continuous constraint admission checks, and ARC frontier validation when upstream dependencies remain unchanged.
Instrument the CUDA failure localization and qualification runner with granular intra-task phase timers (driver check, device context init, host-to-device transfer, contract binding).
Persist explicit synchronous start and end execution timestamps directly into experiment receipt artifacts during conductor execution to eliminate reliance on disk-mtime fallback reconstruction.
Capture continuous in-flight accelerator utilization and memory metrics during compute-bound execution to corroborate point-in-time GPU monitor reports.
Maintain strict DualGPURunner dispatch boundaries to concurrent multi-model execution, avoiding misapplication to single-model or diagnostic workloads.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Deploy incremental receipt caching and memoization for fourteen-outcome reconciliation and dependency-scoped constraint admission checks when upstream evidence remains static.
Instrument compute-bound CUDA diagnostics and long synthesis validation routines with granular intra-task execution phase timers.
Persist explicit start and end lifecycle timestamps in experiment receipts and capture continuous in-flight GPU utilization telemetry.
meta_reflection: Across 6 completed experiments and 69.0 minutes of wall time, execution latency was heavily concentrated in synthesis tasks led by fourteen-outcome reconciliation (20.94 minutes) and dependency-scoped constraint admission (15.18 minutes), while the sole compute-bound experiment required 8.29 minutes to localize CUDA failure and bind its qualified contract. GPU utilization was observed at 0% post-run on the RTX 3090 representing expected idle behavior for non-accelerated synthesis workloads with gpu_idle_on_compute_bound_tasks recorded as false. Tooling improvements should prioritize incremental receipt caching for repetitive synthesis reconciliations and fine-grained intra-task phase timers, with estimated time savings conservatively held at 0% pending empirical measurement.
